steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to ERPNext at http://127.0.0.1:8100/ as Administrator using the password exactly as {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}, and verify the signed-in app is open.
02-report: Report the customer names of all existing Sales Orders whose customer name starts with 'Seed:' exactly as shown on their records. Do not modify any Sales Orders.

03-create: Create a customer named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Customer' in ERPNext using default customer group and territory if needed. Save it and verify the customer record exists with that exact name.

04-create: Create and save a Sales Order for the exact customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with delivery date 2026-12-31. Select the customer from its link-field suggestions, not just typed text. Satisfy any mandatory fields needed to save (including a minimal valid item line if required), and report the saved order's customer, delivery date, status, and record URL.

05-set: On Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} for '{{runid}} Bench Customer', set the Items table to exactly two lines: select Bench Widget with quantity 3 and its default rate, and Bench Gadget with quantity 2 and its default rate. Remove any other item lines, save, and verify both exact item names, quantities, rates, customer, and delivery date 2026-12-31.

06-verify: Submit Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} for '{{runid}} Bench Customer'. Confirm the submission when ERPNext asks, then verify the record is submitted (not draft), reporting its status and record ID.
07-add: Add a comment to the timeline of Sales Order {{04-create.url.p2}} with text that includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Save/post it and verify the timeline visibly contains the comment.
